### sudo-restart | kinds=write | flags=
sudo systemctl restart nginx

### sudo-u-read | kinds=read | flags=
sudo -u root -n cat /etc/os-release

### timeout-read | kinds=read | flags=
timeout 30 journalctl -u nginx --no-pager

### nice-read | kinds=read | flags=
nice -n 10 ls -la

### env-pct | kinds=read | flags= | inner=pct:103
env FOO=bar pct exec 103 -- hostname

### pct-docker | kinds=read | flags= | inner=pct:103,docker:web01
pct exec 103 -- docker exec -it web01 date

### docker-exec-sh | kinds=read,read | flags= | inner=docker:web01
docker exec -it web01 sh -c 'journalctl -u app | tail -n 5'

### compose-exec | kinds=read | flags= | inner=docker:web
docker compose -f docker-compose.yml exec web uptime

### su-c | kinds=read | flags=
su - root -c 'cat /etc/hostname'

### sh-c | kinds=read,read | flags=
sh -c 'ls -la; df -h'

### depth3-ok | kinds=read | flags=
sudo sudo sudo ls

### depth4-unknown | kinds=unknown | flags= | complete=false
sudo sudo sudo sudo ls

### pct-status | kinds=read | flags=
pct status 103

### qm-guest-exec | kinds=read | inner=qm:201
qm guest exec 201 -- uptime
